behaviors_asserted: Provide a universal cache() middleware with a storage adapter interface.
CacheStore interface must provide get(key): Promise<CacheEntry | null>, set(key, entry, ttlSeconds): Promise<void>, and delete(key): Promise<void>.
Middleware options include store, ttl (seconds), keyGenerator (default: full URL), vary (array of header names), and condition (predicate deciding whether to cache).
Default store should be an in-process LRU MemoryStore with zero dependencies.
Existing Cloudflare Cache API behavior should be migrated to a CloudflareKVStore adapter.
